sentences.en: You just need time to adjust to the new paradigm.
sentences.zh: 你只需要时间来适应新的范式。

sentences.en: Most people don't like the paradigm of your religion.
sentences.zh: 大多数人不喜欢你的宗教所代表的观念体系。

sentences.en: A paradigm is something you think about before you think about it.
sentences.zh: 范式是你在思考之前就已经接受并遵循的一种思维模式。
